$comment: Review gate for requester notices (agent/notify-requester.mjs, agent/notify-shared-blocker.mjs; rules in agent/notice-review.mjs). Before a notice reaches a requester, the bot DMs the reviewer the exact text and the reviewer reacts: the send reaction sends it through the normal notifier path, the hold reaction holds it, no reaction for expiryDays expires it. reviewMode "all" sends every notice through review (now); "flagged" sends unflagged notices directly with --send and only the flagRules matches through review (later, once the wording has settled). Reactions are read through conversations.history's reactions field on the reviewer message (im:history), because the marketing_support bot has no reactions:read (checked 2026-09-23); only the reviewer's own reaction counts, and hold wins when both are present. The pending items live in a local JSON-lines ledger (env NOTICE_REVIEW_LEDGER, else ledger.defaultPath, else work/notice-review.jsonl in this checkout), polled by agent/notice-review-poll.mjs.

flagRules.reason: an item is a question rather than an attach-a-file ask
flagRules.detail: A Missing Info item is an attach-a-file ask when it names a file the requester attaches (headshot, photo, bio, logo, file, PDF) and asks nothing else; an item with a question mark, an either-or choice, or an interrogative word (who, what, which, whether, when, where, why, how, does, should) is a question. Blocked notices and shared-blocker DMs tell, they do not ask, so this rule does not flag them.

flagRules.reason: the recipient is outside the internal domains
flagRules.detail: The requester email's domain is not one of internalDomains.

flagRules.reason: a shared-blocker channel note is read by everyone in the channel
flagRules.detail: Every channel note goes through review in both modes; the DMs that point at it depend on the note being sent and wait for their own reaction.
